poi.name: Città Alta (Upper Town)
poi.description: The historic upper town of Bergamo, known for its medieval walls, narrow streets, and panoramic views.

poi.name: Piazza Vecchia
poi.description: A central square in the upper town, surrounded by historic buildings and considered one of Italy's most beautiful squares.

poi.name: Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore
poi.description: A Romanesque basilica dating back to the 12th century, famous for its rich Baroque interior and historical artworks.

poi.name: Colleoni Chapel
poi.description: A Renaissance mausoleum built for Bartolomeo Colleoni, admired for its elaborate façade and artistic decorations.

poi.name: Accademia Carrara
poi.address: Piazza Giacomo Carrara, 82, 24121 Bergamo BG, Italy
poi.description: An important art gallery hosting a rich collection of Renaissance and Baroque masterpieces.

poi.name: GAMeC (Gallery of Modern and Contemporary Art)
poi.address: Via San Tomaso, 53, 24121 Bergamo BG, Italy
poi.description: A modern art museum featuring contemporary exhibitions, educational programs, and cultural events.

poi.name: Bergamo Cathedral (Duomo di Bergamo)
poi.description: A neoclassical cathedral dedicated to Saint Alexander, with beautiful interiors and significant religious artworks.

poi.name: Rocca di Bergamo
poi.address: Via alla Rocca, 24129 Bergamo BG, Italy
poi.description: A medieval fortress offering historical exhibits and impressive views over the city and surrounding hills.
